mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_document_annotation (id, document_id, document_version_id, author_id, char_start, char_end, content, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{idHex}), HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{versionIdHex}), HEXTORAW(#{authorIdHex}), #{charStart}, #{charEnd}, #{content}, 'O')
mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(a.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(a.document_id) AS documentId, RAWTOHEX(a.document_version_id) AS documentVersionId, RAWTOHEX(a.author_id) AS authorId, au.display_name AS authorName, au.username AS authorAccount, a.char_start AS charStart, a.char_end AS charEnd, a.content AS content, a.status AS status, RAWTOHEX(a.resolved_by) AS resolvedBy, ru.display_name AS resolvedByName, a.resolved_time AS resolvedTime, a.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_document_annotation a JOIN edudoc_user au ON au.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_user ru ON ru.id = a.resolved_by WHERE a.document_id = HEXTORAW(#{documentIdHex}) AND a.status = #{status} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM edudoc_document_annotation a JOIN edudoc_user au ON au.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_user ru ON ru.id = a.resolved_by WHERE a.id = HEXTORAW(#{annotationIdHex})
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_document_annotation SET status = 'R', resolved_by = HEXTORAW(#{resolvedByHex}), resolved_time = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{annotationIdHex})
UPDATE edudoc_document_annotation SET status = 'O', resolved_by = NULL, resolved_time = NULL WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{annotationIdHex})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM edudoc_document_annotation WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{annotationIdHex})
